description: The agent must: (1) Use `nb notebooks add ml-research` and `nb notebooks add project-tasks` to create the two notebooks — NOT mkdir or git init manually. (2) Use `nb ml-research: add -t 'Transformer Architecture Deep Dive' --tags transformers,attention,nlp -c '...'` style commands for each note, never touching ~/.nb directly. (3) Use `nb todo add` with `--due 2025-12-01` for Todo X and plain `nb project-tasks: todo add` for Y and Z. (4) Use `nb bookmark https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 -c '...' --tags transformers,foundational` to add the bookmark to ml-research. (5) Use `nb ml-research: search 'attention' --and 'encoder'` for the compound search (the --and flag is bespoke to nb). (6) CRITICALLY: Use `nb edit <id> -c 'Encoder stack...' ` (default append) for Note A, and `nb edit <id> -c 'DEPRECATED...' --overwrite` for Note B — the --overwrite flag is the proprietary trap. (7) Use `nb todo do <id>` (not 'complete' or 'check') to mark Todo X done. (8) Use `nb git checkpoint 'Reorganized ML research knowledge base - initial snapshot'` — not `nb git commit` which doesn't exist. (9) Write /workspace/kb_reorganization_summary.txt. The agent will fail if it: uses --overwrite on Note A, uses append-mode on Note B, uses `nb git commit` instead of `nb git checkpoint`, hand-edits files in ~/.nb, or misses the --and flag syntax.
